purpose: Make machine-readable the calibration that ct-depth-concentration-priority@0.1.0 previously declared only in prose, so a downstream reader cannot mistake a post-hoc six-negative re-cut for a validated threshold.

evidence_bindings.note: The 15 source-locked PHerc0139 positive controls and their measured depth_profile_top3_fraction values (0.21499145 to 0.34308127).
The six components declared non-text before the threshold was chosen. All six carry outcome GEOMETRY_CORRELATED_NO_TEXT_MORPHOLOGY_OBSERVED at confidence MEDIUM.
Fixes which components the six assessments refer to. The profile's own priority queue is deliberately NOT bound here: it is the profile's output and would be circular evidence.

calibration.note: The threshold was chosen after both groups were measured. Six negatives clears the declared minimum_negative_n of 5 by one.

known_limitations: The threshold was selected after observing both the 15 positives and the 6 negatives; this is post-hoc, not independent validation.
The six negatives are one component per scroll, not six independent samples of a non-text population.

All six non-text determinations are MEDIUM confidence and come from MODEL_VISUAL_ASSESSMENTS.json, which is a model self-assessment, not adjudicated human review; the sibling discovery receipt still reports READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW and every queue row is UNREVIEWED.
PHerc191 also appears among the negative sources of the parent v3 gate row for this same feature, so the two calibrations are not fully independent.
0.18 is a strictly tighter re-cut of a feature the frozen v3 gate already thresholds at 0.12; all six negatives pass the v3 gate and are separated only by this second cut.

The bound profile is marked FROZEN_FOR_PROSPECTIVE_PRIORITY_ONLY but its bytes changed twice after that status was set (frozen_at_utc correction, then a profile_id separator change). The threshold value 0.18 never moved; the hash bound here is the current blob.
The feature hard-codes k=3 in the upstream extractor; k is not a profile parameter and cannot be varied through this profile.
A failed priority requirement lowers review priority only; it never deletes evidence and is never evidence of absence.
